description: Import and Export Control Department - Imports and Exports (Control) Regulation No. 07 of 2020
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, which involves legal/regulatory matters. It specifically promulgates new regulations (Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 07 of 2020) that modify import controls by deleting certain items from previous schedules. This falls under "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" as defined in Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
